GAUSTA SKI & RESORT AS (org.nr 891 680 422) is registered as Aksjeselskap (AS), founded 2007-06-30, registered 2007-09-10. [brreg_enheter] Business address: Kvitåvatnvegen 372, 3660 RJUKAN. [brreg_enheter] Leadership: general manager (daglig leder) Andreas Smith-Erichsen; board chair Nils Mikael Jönsson; 2 other board members. [brreg_roller]

- Registered employees: 144 (as of 2026-09-10); 2 registered sub-units. [brreg_enheter]
